summary: Kootenai National Forest L-6 cab in Lincoln County, built 1934 and abandoned 1942; the Montana index lists the site as gone and no source describes it today.

facts.status_note: Montana index lists the site as gone; the firelookout.com page gives its date range as 1934 with an unknown end year

evidence.quote: This L-6 cab, built in 1934, was abandoned in 1942.

evidence.supports: agency is the Kootenai National Forest
listed under Kootenai National Forest at 34N-32W-19 on the Lincoln County list
county Lincoln, coordinates, ground type, status gone
page date range ends in an unknown year

notes_for_editor: Only one narrative source (firelookout.com) exists. The Forest Lookouts Lincoln County list has a heading and township line for Pleasant View and no narrative. The story is about 90 words; the evidence is thin, so it stays short rather than padded. No staffing, fire or current-site source was found. A YouTube video titled 'Finding a Forgotten Fire Lookout... Abandoned Since 1942' surfaced in search, but its page text names no site, so it was not used. Used 2 searches and about 4 page reads.
